management_steps.details: CCF: 25 to 50 mg daily. Hypertension (Step 2 / 3 / 5 / 6): 12.5 mg daily. Hypertension (Step 7): 25 mg daily.
Caution in patients with gout. Less effective in impaired renal function. Higher doses can cause hyponatraemia.

warnings: Caution in patients with a history or family history of skin cancer; counsel all patients on sun avoidance and sun protection.
